_meta.what: Curated ticker -> en.wikipedia article-title seed for the attention stream (BUILD ORDER 5 #3). v1 is deliberately small: only pairs verified by hand against the live pageviews API (all-access/user, daily). Article titles use the API's underscore encoding.
_meta.expansion_rule: grow only after gate 1 (views-vs-known-events hand-check) passes; every added pair needs the same 200-probe + correct-article check. True small caps often lack articles — that absence is data, not a bug. RIOT was dropped at curation: both candidate titles failed the probe (article renamed; pageviews does not follow redirects).
